newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Time gets okay for Sapura, Uniphone deals.
newsitem.headline: Time gets okay for Sapura, Uniphone deals.

text.p: Malaysia's Time Engineering Bhd said on Friday it has received approval from the Securities Commission for its planned acquisitions of two telecommunications firms from Sapura Holdings Sdn Bhd.

The acquisitions involved a 75 percent equity stake in cellular phone company Sapura Digital Sdn Bhd for 750 million ringgit, and 450 million ringgit for 75 percent of payphone operator Uniphone Sdn Bhd.

In a statement issued by Time's merchant bankers, the telecommunications and engineering firm said the approval was given with a number of conditions. These include submitting valuation reports and detailing cashflow projections of the two companies.
Time has said previously that it would pay for the 1.2 billion ringgit purchase with the issue of 185 million new Time shares at 6.50 ringgit a share to Sapura Holdings.
The share swap would make Sapura Holdings a 13 percent shareholder in Time.
